content: Yesus po saumane raunande vatano jorame ai no masyoto sambaya rai
Masyoto sambaya inta, Yesus siso no yavaro sambaya inta ama uga. Vatano aneme rani nsawa inta no no naije tavon.
Weti vatano Parisije inta wo Yesus anyanyuti tutira ware tugaeya rako Po saumane raunande arono masyoto sambaya raija rako? Weye wo Apa ayao kakaije rakani indamu wo aura tantunawi.
Umba Yesus po raura nanto vatano aneme rani nsawa umawe ai pare, “Windento nte no usye so.”

Umba Yesus po raura nanto vatano una no we mansai pare, “Syare syo wasanajo rati. Mamaisyo wama ananyao raijamo, rui mirati wamo rave no masyoto sambaya rai: Wamo ana ngkove rave rako, ngkakaije mi wamo raveye? Wamo vatane mapaya irati kakaije rai rako, wamo maubaisye?” Weramu vatane umanin bintabo.

Yesus po maen tenambe, pari. Muno animaumbe tavon weye manuga matu. Umba Po raura nanto vatano aneme rani nsawa umawe ai pare, “Naneme raojaito!” Umba vatane umawe po aneme raojaito, naije kobe aneme nsauman.
Umba vatano Parisije wuje yavaro sambaya raora, umba wavave wo vatano usisa varoro Akarijo Titi Herodes aije mawain indamu wanyinyaube tenambe, ware wo Yesus aubaisy.
Yesus pananyaube muno Po saumane raunanto vatano ujajorame mai
Yesusa pe apa arakovo utavondi aije nawe wuje wuruta no onae tuga Galilea, muno vatano Galilea wanui rave utavondi. Muno vatano una no Yudea wanui ude Ai tavon,

muno vatano una no Yerusalem, vatano una no Idumea, vatano una no ranijo muramo mana Yordan, vatano una mararaijo munijo Tirus muno munijo Sidon. Vatane umaso ude no Yesusa nui weye wo Apa anapaporainye ranaun.
Vatane so wanui rave, wetiva Yesus po apa arakovo utavondi aije matutir wo nyomane inta ratayao Ai indamu seo tuna ama vone rai, inda vemo vatano wanuije wo akikipi jinya.
Weye Po saumane raunanto vatano ugwanen wanui mansai to, weti vatano ugwanen kaijinta ude Ai, wo akikipi weye ware ubeker wantukamo Ai.
Vatano anawayo kakaije siso maije ude tavon. Arono anawayo kakaije umaso wo Yesus aen, ubeaje no Amun umba ugwain ware, “Winyamo Arikainyo Amisye pi Winy!”
Weramu Yesus po anawayo kakaije umaso maorai indamu vemo wo aura kakavimbe inya.
Yesus po apa arakovo abusyinara eane rurum mawainde
Umba Yesus seo no pukame inta rai, umba Po vatano bekero maije mawain, weti ude Ai.

Umba Po vatane abusyinara eane rurum mapatimu, pare, “Weapamo Sya arakovo syo wasatutire nawi weap. Syo wasawain indamu watavondi Rinai, muno Syo wasatutir indamu wapo Ayao Kovo Amisye raura vatane mai.
Muno Syo vambunine raunande wasai indamu wapo anawayo kakaije mawatan.”
Weti Yesus apa arakovo mansano abusyinara eane rurum awa tame mi som: Simon (apa tamo Yesus po raura tavona Petrus),
Yakobus, apa rijato Yohanes (wenayamo Sebedeus apa arikainye naya, weramu Yesus po yawainamo Boanerges, ama ine mare “arikainyo katitir”),
Andreas, Pilipus, Bartolomeus, Matius, Tomas, Yakobus (Alpeus apa kavo pije), Tadeus, Simon (opi awainamo vatano Zelot),
Yudas Iskariot (opi po Yesus amavun).
Yesus apa vambunin muno Anakakai Akoe apa vambunin
Umbawe Yesus pakato no yavar. Naije vatano wanuije ude wanunugambe akato, weti Yesusa pe apa arakovo utavondi aije nawe wisyisye ramu.
Arono Apa yavaruga wo ana umaso ranaun, wo raura ware, “Yesus be anaivivea rako?” weti wuruta ware wo augav.
Kuruno makari mbaro Ananyao Musa rai inta una no Yerusalem ude, umba wo raura ware, “Akarijo anawayo kakai, apa tame mi Bersebur,
siso Yesus ai to, weti wepi po vambunine raunande Ai indamu Po anawayo kakaije mawatambe!”
Yesus po mawain ude mararai, umba Po ananeneae inta raura nanto mai. Pare, “Anakakai Akoe po taune mawatano vatane maora kakai.
Ranivara munije inta ama vatane maporabe jirum ti inta umarovave inta mai, wea umba munije umaso mandamisy.
Muno ranivara yavaruga maporabe jirum ti inta umarovave inta mai, wea umba mandamisy tavon.

Anakakai Akoe apa munijo be akarive raije maisyare wemai tavon. Ranivara Anakakai Akoe pe apa anawayo kakaije nawe maporabe jirum ti taune umarovave taune mansai, weamo apa munijo be akarive rai noa nugoenta ramu, yara mandamisy.

Syo ananeneae inta raura: Ranivara vatano panaonoambe inta siso vatano bambunine apa yavare rai, weamo po vatane umaso aneme ajoe raokokai dati, umba po apa ananugo yavarugawe raugavo aora tenambe. Anakakai Akoe aurata irati vatano bambunine umaso ai, muno Risyamo syo apinde to, wemi mbewar Syo anawayo kakaije mawatan.
Syo raura tugaive: vatane awa ayao kakai rui vayave muno awa ayao wo Amisye aura tantunawi, Amisye pare po rapaya mai arono usakinavo rai.
Yara are pirati po Anawayo Vambunine raura tantunawi, opamo Amisye po apa ayao kakaije umaso rapaya aije ramu. Yara Apa parije no aija nuge nuganui.”
Yesus po rauranare wemaisy, weye vatane umawe wo raura ware, “Yesus opamo anawayo kakaije siso Ai to.”
Yesus apa akoya me Apa rijate nawe ude Ai
Umba naije Yesus apa akoya me Apa rijate nawe ude usai no yavare akirije umu. Umba wo vatane inta atutir ware po Yesus awain inda puje.
Vatane wanui rave utantuna Yesus akiani, ti inta wo raura nanto Ai ware, “Nya ingkoa me Nya rijate nawe usai no akiri umuga ware ubeker indamu wo naen.”
Yesus po raura nanto mai pare, “Are nawirati Sya akoe, Sya arakove waino mansai?”
Umba sarirae ara Po raura nanto vatano utantuna akianije mansai pare, “Sya ingkoa me Sya arakove wenawi utantuna so,
weye vatano anya, wanya utavondijo Amisye apa bekere raije wenawirati Sya akoe waino mai muno Sya arakove waino mai.”

footnotes.text: Tamo Bersebur ama ine mare Anakakai Akoe pije.
